title.narrative: Enhanced reports received by the Federal Account Allocation Committee (FAAC) from NNPCL

comment.narrative: The FMF reported that the enhanced FAAC reporting template was approved during March 2025 FAAC meeting with of Commissioners Of Finance. Implementation of the revised template is set to commence by June 2025. However, during the November ISM, FMF reported that the new template is yet to be used.

title.narrative: VAT collection as a percentage of non oil GDP

comment.narrative: The DLI was achieved as at December 2024 and was impacted by: (1) Introduction of withholding tax on VAT on key sectors (telecom and banking). (2) Taxpayer education through sensitization and engagements. (3) Removal of implicit FX subsidy

title.narrative: Customs registered, accredited, and compliant firms

comment.narrative: In addition to the 6 companies that were accredited as at the last mission, the NCS accessed over 400 companies for the AEO program during the period under review. While 45 companies were accredited and certified, 200 companies were place on compliance improvement plan for various reasons. The NCS will continue to work with the companies and accredit as they make progress.

FIRS reported that the expected CIT filers increased from 225,130 in 2024 to 292,392 in 2025 and CIT online on time VAT filers from 92,424 to 102,438 for the same period. However, increase in base resulted to percentage decrease in compliance from 41% in 2024 to 34% in 2025.

The baseline data of 472,060 was obtained from the FIRS legacy web portal, which included unvalidated entries due to duplications resulting from multiple taxpayer registrations. The current number of expected filers is as at January 2025.

title.narrative: Online ontime VAT filing compliance rate

comment.narrative: FIRS reported that the expected filers increased from 2,507,831 in 2023 to 3,634,105 in 2024 resulting in increase of online on time VAT filers from 1,021,342 to 1,171,916. The increase in base resulted to percentage decrease in compliance from 41% in 2023 to 32% in 2024.

title.narrative: Federal Account Allocation Committee (FAAC) approves enhanced template for NNPCL reporting. (YES/NO)

comment.narrative: FAAC has approved revised reporting template and issued Directive to NNPC to submit revenue reports that has minimum contents including detailed information on (i) the use of Domestic Crude Allocation, (ii) existing liabilities, (iii) forward crude oil sales (iv) and outstanding fiscal and regulatory (such as gas flare) payments etc

actual.value: The enhanced FAAC reports template was approved in March 2025, the implementation of the new template is expected to commence by June 2025.
